text_001.en: Peking University · School of Integrated Circuits
text_001.zh: 北京大学 · 集成电路学院

text_002.en: Thermal Management and Advanced Packaging for Future Integrated Circuits
text_002.zh: 面向未来集成电路的热管理与先进封装

text_003.en: We focus on thermal management, heterogeneous integration, and advanced packaging technologies for next-generation integrated circuits through innovations in materials, devices, and thermal characterizations.
text_003.zh: 聚焦高性能集成电路中的热管理、异质集成与先进封装，发展面向下一代芯片的关键材料、器件与表征技术。

text_007.en: Engineering the thermal foundations of tomorrow's chips
text_007.zh: 为下一代芯片构建热学基础

text_009.en: We focus on thermal management, heterogeneous integration, and advanced packaging for future high-performance integrated circuits.
text_009.zh: 我们聚焦未来高性能芯片中的热管理、异质集成与先进封装问题，面向高功率密度、高集成度和高可靠性的集成电路系统，发展关键热调控理论、材料、器件与工艺技术。

text_010.en: We address critical thermal challenges in chips with increasing power density, integration density, and reliability requirements, connecting fundamental understanding with measurement techniques and engineering solutions.
text_010.zh: 我们围绕微纳电子器件热输运、界面热阻、三维堆叠芯片散热、半导体材料生长与先进热表征开展研究，建立面向先进集成电路的热设计、测试与优化方法。

text_013.en: From nanoscale interfaces to integrated systems
text_013.zh: 从纳米界面到集成系统

text_014.en: We investigate the thermal behavior, design, and characterization of complex chip structures across scales.
text_014.zh: 跨尺度研究复杂芯片结构的热行为、热设计与热表征。

text_017.en: Micro- and nanoelectronic heat transport, thermal boundary resistance, and semiconductor materials and devices.
text_017.zh: 微纳电子热输运、界面热阻与半导体材料器件。

text_021.en: Thermal challenges in high-density integration, 3D stacked chips, and advanced electronic packaging.
text_021.zh: 面向高密度集成、三维堆叠芯片与先进封装的热学挑战。

text_025.en: Advanced methods for chip thermal characterization, testing, modeling, and optimization.
text_025.zh: 面向芯片热表征、测试、建模与优化的先进方法。

text_049.en: From nanoscale interfaces to full-chip systems, we connect precise measurement with engineering insight to reveal, understand, and control heat in advanced integrated circuits.
text_049.zh: 从纳米界面到芯片系统，我们将精密测量与工程分析相结合，致力于揭示、理解并调控先进集成电路中的热输运过程。

text_050.en: A platform for advanced thermal characterization

text_051.en: Our work spans thermal transport in micro/nanoelectronic devices, interface heat transfer, heat dissipation in 3D stacked chips, semiconductor materials growth, and advanced thermal characterization.
text_051.zh: 研究覆盖微纳电子器件热输运、界面热传递、三维堆叠芯片散热、半导体材料生长与先进热表征。

text_057.en: Driven by curiosity and collaboration, we develop innovative solutions in IC thermal management, heterogeneous integration, and advanced packaging for the next generation of high-performance chips.
text_057.zh: 以好奇心与协作精神为驱动，我们聚焦集成电路热管理、异质集成与先进封装，为下一代高性能芯片探索创新技术与解决方案。

text_058.en: A collaborative lab for the next generation of IC researchers
text_058.zh: 面向下一代集成电路研究者的协作型实验室

text_059.en: We welcome motivated students and young researchers from integrated circuits, electronic engineering, materials science, physics, mechanical engineering, energy science, and related fields.
text_059.zh: 我们欢迎来自集成电路、电子信息、材料、物理、机械、能源等相关领域的学生与青年学者加入。

text_063.en: Let’s address the thermal challenges of integrated electronics
text_063.zh: 共同应对集成电子系统的热学挑战
